name: Nethervault Whispers
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level witch 1, wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You fill the subject’s mind with unintelligible, telepathic whispers which seem to originate somewhere behind it.

Every creature making a melee attack against the subject is considered to be flanking the subject, even if the attacker has no ally in the necessary opposing position.

The subject is not otherwise distracted or hampered by the whispers in its mind.
